## Summary
The 2026-11-02 nightly (d8ffd8f) had 490 failures, almost all `can_not_install` on macOS R 4.2 (the `websocket` source build failed against openssl@4); only 1 was snapshot-related. `fix_snaps` applied 15 patches, and I kept the minute changes: a tiny embedded-PNG drift in `020-knit-html` (mac-4.6) and routine sysinfo metadata refreshes.

## Minute Changes Accepted
- `020-knit-html` `_snaps/mac-4.6/mytest/001.json` and `003.json`: only the base64 PNG in the `report` html output changed. The PNG is still 504x360, the byte size moved about 1-2% (18844 to 18459 and 20853 to 20658), and all non-image content is identical. This is the same kind of rendering drift accepted in the previous snapshot PRs.
- `inst/apps/sysinfo-linux-4.2` to `4.6`, `sysinfo-mac-4.5`, `sysinfo-mac-4.6`, and `sysinfo-win-4.2` to `4.6`: generated environment metadata (dates, Chrome 156/157, gha_image, R patch version, package versions).

## Needs Human Review
- `inst/apps/sysinfo-mac-4.2.txt`, `sysinfo-mac-4.3.txt`, `sysinfo-mac-4.4.txt` (reverted): these reflect a broken macOS run, not a real environment change. The package list shrank from 227 to about 150 lines, and chromote dropped to CRAN 0.5.1 from 0.5.1.9000. This matches the `websocket` build failure against openssl@4 (`/opt/homebrew/Cellar/openssl@4/4.1.0`) on macOS 4.2/4.3/4.4, which caused the 000-all to 149-onRender `can_not_install` failures. Needs a CI/infra fix (pin openssl or the `websocket` build), not a snapshot update.
- The rest of the 490 failures (about 489) are macOS R 4.2 install failures and are not snapshot-related, so nothing was changed for them.

## Commands Run
- `Rscript -e 'shinycoreci::fix_snaps(sha = "d8ffd8f", ask_apps = FALSE, ask_branches = FALSE, ask_if_not_main = FALSE)'` - passed (15 patches applied cleanly)
- `git status --short` / `git diff -- inst/apps` - passed (inspected the diffs)
- Python comparison of the `020-knit-html` JSON before and after (PNG dimensions and non-image content) - passed
- `git checkout -- inst/apps/sysinfo-mac-4.2.txt inst/apps/sysinfo-mac-4.3.txt inst/apps/sysinfo-mac-4.4.txt` - passed (reverted the degraded sysinfo)
